extraMeanings.en: a quantity or symbol that can represent different values
extraMeanings.exampleEn: In the equation, x is the variable you need to solve for.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Denklemde x, çözmen gereken değişkendir.

extraMeanings.en: differing from a standard or from others of the same type
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There are several variant spellings of the word.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kelimenin birkaç farklı yazımı vardır.

extraMeanings.en: to jump over something in a single movement, using your hands or a pole
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He vaulted over the fence and ran into the field.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çiti atlayıp tarlaya doğru koştu.

extraMeanings.en: an opening that allows air, gas, or smoke to pass through
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Warm air came out of the heating vent.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Isıtma menfezinden sıcak hava çıkıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: one of the sections of a song, as opposed to the chorus
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She forgot the words to the second verse of the song.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şarkının ikinci kıtasının sözlerini unuttu.

extraMeanings.en: a particular account of an event from someone's point of view
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her version of what happened was completely different from his.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Olanlara dair onun anlatımı, adamınkinden tamamen farklıydı.

extraMeanings.en: to a great degree; extremely
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She was very tired after the long journey.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uzun yolculuktan sonra çok yorgundu.

extraMeanings.en: (of a device) to shake with rapid small movements to signal something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My phone vibrated in my pocket during the meeting.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Toplantı sırasında telefonum cebimde titredi.

extraMeanings.en: not legally valid or binding
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The contract was declared void by the court.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme mahkeme tarafından geçersiz ilan edildi.

extraMeanings.en: to officially cancel or make invalid
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They voided the ticket because it had already been used.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bilet zaten kullanıldığı için onu iptal ettiler.

extraMeanings.en: to offer to do something without being asked or forced
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She volunteered to help organize the charity event.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hayır etkinliğini düzenlemeye yardım etmek için gönüllü oldu.

extraMeanings.en: to bring up food from the stomach through the mouth
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He felt sick and vomited after eating the spoiled fish.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bozuk balığı yedikten sonra midesi bulandı ve kustu.

extraMeanings.en: to make a serious promise to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He vowed never to make the same mistake again.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Aynı hatayı bir daha yapmamaya yemin etti.

extraMeanings.en: to bet a sum of money on the result of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He wagered fifty dollars on his favorite horse.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Favori atına elli dolar bahis oynadı.

extraMeanings.en: to stay in a place until something happens or someone arrives
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We had to wait an hour for the next train.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir sonraki tren için bir saat beklemek zorunda kaldık.

extraMeanings.en: to have a desire for something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I want a cup of coffee before we leave.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gitmeden önce bir fincan kahve istiyorum.

extraMeanings.en: to make cloth by crossing threads over and under each other
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The women weave beautiful carpets by hand.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kadınlar el ile güzel halılar dokuyor.

extraMeanings.en: to move along by turning and changing direction to avoid obstacles
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The motorcyclist weaved through the heavy traffic.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Motosikletli, yoğun trafiğin arasından süzülerek geçti.

extraMeanings.en: to remove wild plants from a garden or area
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She spent the afternoon weeding the vegetable garden.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğleden sonrayı sebze bahçesindeki yabani otları ayıklayarak geçirdi.

extraMeanings.en: a film or book about cowboys in the American West
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My grandfather loves watching old westerns on TV.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Büyükbabam televizyonda eski kovboy filmleri izlemeyi çok sever.

extraMeanings.en: a long piece of leather or rope used to hit animals or people
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The rider cracked his whip to make the horse go faster.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Binici, atı hızlandırmak için kırbacını şaklattı.

extraMeanings.en: to close and open one eye quickly, usually as a friendly signal
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She winked at me to show she was joking.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şaka yaptığını göstermek için bana göz kırptı.

extraMeanings.en: an act of cleaning something by rubbing it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Give the table a quick wipe before dinner.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yemekten önce masayı hızlıca bir sil.

extraMeanings.en: to see something happen, especially an event or crime
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Several people witnessed the accident on the highway.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Birkaç kişi otoyoldaki kazaya tanık oldu.

extraMeanings.en: to combine two different things or qualities
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The design weds traditional style with modern technology.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tasarım, geleneksel tarzı modern teknolojiyle birleştiriyor.

extraMeanings.en: to be successful or victorious in a contest or competition
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Our team won the match in the final minute.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Takımımız maçı son dakikada kazandı.

extraMeanings.en: a type of malicious program that spreads through computer networks
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The worm spread quickly across thousands of computers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Solucan virüsü binlerce bilgisayara hızla yayıldı.

extraMeanings.en: to show respect and love for a god through religious activities
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They gather every Sunday to worship at the church.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Her Pazar kilisede ibadet etmek için toplanırlar.

extraMeanings.en: to love or admire someone very much
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She absolutely worships her older brother.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ağabeyine adeta tapıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to destroy or badly damage something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The storm wrecked several houses along the coast.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Fırtına, kıyı boyunca birkaç evi harap etti.

extraMeanings.en: to open the mouth wide and breathe in deeply because of tiredness
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He yawned loudly during the boring lecture.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sıkıcı ders sırasında yüksek sesle esnedi.

extraMeanings.en: a sudden strong pull
extraMeanings.exampleEn: With one yank, she pulled the rope free.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tek bir sert çekişle ipi kurtardı.

extraMeanings.en: to cause someone to become a widow or widower
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She was widowed at a young age when her husband died in the war.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kocası savaşta ölünce genç yaşta dul kaldı.

extraMeanings.en: the ability to think quickly and make good decisions
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She had the wit to call for help immediately.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hemen yardım çağıracak akla sahipti.

extraMeanings.en: the year or place in which a particular wine was produced
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This bottle is from an excellent vintage.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu şişe mükemmel bir mahsul yılına ait.

extraMeanings.tr: dönme, fırıl fırıl dönüş; telaş, koşuşturma (isim)
extraMeanings.en: a fast spinning movement, or a state of busy activity
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her life was a whirl of parties and social events.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hayatı, partiler ve sosyal etkinliklerden oluşan bir koşuşturmaydı.
